b.x: What operational secrecy is

Operational secrecy — OPSEC, in the public pamphlet — is not a film cloak. It is the craft of treating the house’s information as the survivalist treats water: what leaks does not return. Whoever knows point B, the stock, the travel date, the child’s school name, route A, is already part of the mission. Whoever does not need to know and still knows, in a blackout, chooses the door. Gray does not hide a crime. Gray hides margin.

The military field (military gray) already gave AR 530-1’s five-step cycle. This field is Tuesday’s technique: the list of what must not leak, need-to-know, mouth, trash, routine, photo, the family briefing. Digital covers cloud and Bluetooth. Here the body in the room fits — what the mouth, the trash bag, and the usual hour hand over without the phone.
NOTE
Power, here, is margin: not being mapped. It is not ruling the other. The 37 laws refuse the sword. This field refuses the information stage.
What this field refuses

It is not vanishing from the police. Not a false identity. Not jamming radio, plates, street cameras. Not classified TTP, SERE evasion, ‘how to leave no trace for the authority’. The local law rules. Emergency numbers on the tongue. If the scene wounds, you call — you do not vanish.
Does not teach lying to authority, nor destroying evidence.
Does not teach watching a neighbour with an illegal camera, nor breaking into a network.
Does not teach ‘vanishing’ from debt, child support, or a lawsuit.
Teaching the opposite is a stage — and, in many cases, a crime.
DON'T
If the reason for secrecy is hiding a crime, stop. This notebook is not an accomplice. Gray margin belongs to a lawful family, not to what the law has already named.
The list of what must not leak

Doctrine calls critical information what, if it leaks, harms the house. Write a boring list — on paper, not in the group. One sheet. No film title. The survivalist who does not name what he protects protects everything and therefore nothing.
01 People: names, school, leaving time, who stays alone, allergy, the medicine that cannot be missing.
02 Place: address, point B, routes A and C, the window that shows the pantry, the car’s space.
03 When: travel date, a night the house is empty, the day a large delivery arrives.
04 What: stock, generator, papers, how many days the island lasts, where the folder is.
05 How to talk: the three-word agreement, the note to the out-of-city contact.
DO
One sheet. In the folder, not the chat. If the sheet needs the cloud, the craft is already lost. The digital field explains the rest.
Need-to-know

A compartment. Not romantic distrust. A slice. The child knows the near point and the three-word note — not the stock list. The neighbour who swaps flour knows you exist in a pinch — not route C. The family group with ten cousins is not a compartment: it is a stage. Gray cuts the slice by role, not by affection.
Whoever runs the plan needs the slice they run. The rest is noise and a map.
A new partner, a coworker, a prepper group: zero slice until Tuesday proves it.
A child: the simple, rehearsed, without terror. Near point. The note. Not the inventory.
If everyone knows everything, nobody has secrecy. They have a meeting.
Mouth discipline

Elevator, bus, table, rideshare, the bread line, ‘what do you do?’. The technique is boring: one true, small sentence. Do not invent a life. Do not fill the silence with the bunker. The survivalist who explains the generator at the barbecue has already briefed the thief and the talkative cousin.
01 Answer what was asked, not what the ego wants to show.
02 Work: the street’s boring title, not the tactical hobby.
03 Weekend: ‘at home’, not the blackout drill with a photo.
04 Child at the table: teach not to tell the stock at school. No scare. Like not telling the password.
05 Alcohol and secrecy do not mix. The third beer is a stage.
DO
A drill: one ordinary question (‘travelling?’, ‘and the pantry?’). One true one-line answer, no map. Repeat until it comes out without effort.
Trash, mail, routine

An indicator is what an observer assembles without asking. A generator box in the lobby. A volume of sardine tins in a clear bag. A document envelope in the doorman’s mail. A large delivery on the day you posted ‘we leave Friday’. The same hour at the same gym, the same car in the same space, the last block always the same: a résumé of an empty house. Gray does not vanish. Gray varies the boring.
Trash: gear boxes leave broken down, unbranded, on an ordinary day — not on the story.
Mail: papers and medicine do not sit hours at the desk with a large name.
Window: pantry and pack out of sight of the street and the cheap drone.
Routine: vary the last stretch, the grocer hour, the space. Not a getaway. Not printing the map.
Travel: whoever needs to know, knows. The feed does not.
Photo, screen, metadata

The image travels farther than you. The kitchen background with the shelf. The school uniform in the portrait. The plate on the gate. Location in the file. A lock-screen preview with the point B note. Bluetooth named Tactical-01. The digital field goes deeper on the network. Here the rule is one: if the photo teaches the house, it does not leave.
01 Before sending: background, uniform, window, a document on the table, a child’s face with a school sign.
02 Lock screen: a short note, no map. A notification does not show the agreement.
03 Automatic cloud is a permanent witness. What does not need to go up, does not go up.
04 Wi-Fi and Bluetooth names: the street, not the craft.
The house briefing and the week’s failure

One talk, not a speech. Who knows what. The three-word note. What is not said at school or in the group. Where the sheet is. A five-minute drill. No photo. No Apocalypse fear — fear leaks through the mouth. Gray treats secrecy as hygiene: one failure a week, fixed.
This week: delete one photo, shut one sentence, close one window, change one Bluetooth name.
Kits has the clickable list. Field 37 (laws) binds shadow and stock. Digital, the network. Military gray, the five-step cycle.
DO
Paper in the folder. One failure this Tuesday. A short mouth. The law on the tongue. No stage.
NOTE
Educational content. Not a substitute for professional training, legal advice, or local authorities. It does not teach evading the law.
